input.reason: No registered checks are available, so a prospective networking pilot must be proposed. The claim asserts a specific numerical value (12 ms flow completion time) under a fixed configuration A. The previous feedback confirms the authors' dataset is absent and no archived artifact or measurement input is available. Given the two registered runners (emulated-netem-v1 and real-world-iperf-v1), an emulated pilot using emulated-netem-v1 is the most controlled and reproducible starting point to attempt to reproduce the 12 ms completion time under a synthetic fixed configuration. The real-world runner introduces uncontrolled variables and should follow only if the emulated pilot yields a result. The proposal is a pilot only and does not establish correctness or feasibility. All frozen inputs are preserved as-is; no raw numerical arrays are supplied.

proposal.protocol: Emulated pilot to measure flow_completion_time_ms under fixed configuration A using emulated-netem-v1. Steps: (1) Instantiate a single emulated network path via emulated-netem-v1 with parameters matching configuration A as described in the claim (no additional parameters invented). (2) Inject a synthetic flow of the same type and size implied by the claim context. (3) Record flow_completion_time_ms from flow-start to last-byte-received timestamp. (4) Repeat for N=30 independent flow trials (replication unit: one flow per trial; sample-size rationale: 30 trials provides sufficient observations to estimate mean and variance for a pilot without exceeding budget). (5) Report mean, median, min, max, and standard deviation of flow_completion_time_ms in ms. Compare observed mean against the claimed 12 ms. (6) Stopping rule: halt early if per-trial cost projects to exceed USD 90 total or if 7 elapsed days are reached. (7) Missing-data treatment: exclude trials where the runner reports an error or timeout; if >20% of trials are excluded, flag as inconclusive. (8) Controls: no background traffic; fixed random seed=42 for any stochastic emulation elements; single runner instance to avoid cross-instance variance. (9) Exclusions: trials with runner-reported errors, incomplete flows, or wall-clock duration >10x the claimed value. (10) Statistics: one-sample t-test of observed mean vs. 12 ms (alpha=0.05, two-tailed); report 95% CI. Note: shared emulated environment is not independent human review; pilot scope is narrow and cannot settle a broad paper claim.
